topic.source_contract: Nitrate Vulnerable Zones and Farming Rules for Water evidence

facts.coverage: about 55 percent of land in England
facts.guard: NVZ designation is regulatory geography, not measured candidate pollution
appeal outcome and exact field status require current map review
rules do not establish parcel development suitability
storage rule is not evidence of current operator compliance

facts.scope: all agricultural land managers in England
facts.guard: Farming Rules for Water apply beyond NVZs and are not a planning decision

scope_guards: NVZ designation and Farming Rules for Water are related but distinct regulatory layers.
The 2025-2028 NVZ map must be checked at whole-field level after appeal outcomes.
NVZ status is not a measurement of nitrate concentration on a candidate parcel.
Nitrogen limits, closed periods, risk maps and records depend on crop, manure and holding facts.
Organic-manure storage obligations do not prove a farm is compliant or non-compliant.
Farming Rules for Water apply across England even outside an NVZ.
Agricultural pollution rules are not planning permission, title, contamination liability or development viability.
No score or promotion is written without exact field, current designation, management records, water evidence and planning context.
